Direction name: Ваша орбита. Hero: elegant three-dimensional orbital composition on open background. A central pearl sphere with a cobalt traveler silhouette, three floating realistic hotel-photo mini cards arranged on thin elliptical orbit (forest hideaway, stylish city hotel, seaside retreat). One chosen hotel card slightly bigger and forward, subtle mint small check, no prices. Small coherent pearl icon medallions for a heart, past trip suitcase and tapping gesture are the personalization signals; unobtrusive captions 'Избранное', 'Поездки', 'Ваш выбор' grouped near orbit, not separate content panels. Strong natural premium imagery and depth like reference, no cartoon robot or AI sparkle cliché. Headline exact: 'Отели в вашем стиле' with 'вашем стиле' cobalt. Supporting text exact: 'Учитываем ваши поездки, избранное и то, что вам нравится. Показываем отели под ваши пожелания.' 2 compact sentences, 16px. Balanced hero 340px high. Everything fits screen.

Direction name: Из ленты — в подборку. A focused high-end editorial 3D visual metaphor: several small neutral hotel-photo cards recede into the background as a long curved ribbon/stream, passing through a beautiful cobalt orbital ring; in foreground they become a concise stacked trio of large pearl hotel cards showing attractive photographic properties. Foremost card has a small label 'Для вас' and two compact preference chips 'Тишина' and 'У моря'. Avoid literal funnel machinery, phones inside phones, or a dashboard. Illustrated curved selection path with soft shadows, sculptural cards and a single pearl dot conveys personalization, similar material to reference. Text block below image: headline exact 'Меньше поиска.\nБольше совпадений.' accent second line cobalt. Supporting text exact 'Ваши поездки, избранное и выбор помогают нам собрать отели, которые подходят именно вам.' Small discreet line near entrance of visual 'Общая лента' and near chosen card 'Ваша подборка', no extra explanations. One hero, no additional panels. Fit 390x844 naturally.

Direction name: Совпадение с вами. Distinct clean focused UI-as-illustration rather than a sculptural stream: upper hero is ONE floating upright realistic hotel recommendation card with large warm forest hotel photograph, pearl edges and slight perspective. Behind it only two thin offset cards suggest personalized shortlist. Foreground card text 'Почему подходит вам', two elegant mint tick rows 'Тишина и природа' and 'Завтрак без спешки'. No percentage match, prices, stars or booking action. Beneath card (within illustration), three small pearl circular source icons (suitcase, heart, pointing hand), subtle curved orbital lines converging into card; source labels beneath icons 'Поездки', 'Избранное', 'Ваш выбор' small and readable. Show result first, sources second; purposeful uncluttered hierarchy. Main heading below: exact 'Подборка,\nкоторая понимает вас' with second line cobalt. Supporting text exact 'Учимся на ваших поездках и выборе, учитываем избранное — и находим отели под ваши пожелания.' Keep text concise, humane and confident. More grounded product-card composition than abstract 3D diagram, same material palette as reference. Bottom standard footer unchanged. Natural 390x844 portrait.
